surprises: OBSERVATION (routed 73076, reproduced by 2.0.0_SA_COO~X and ruled in 73105): comp-keys prefix truncates to 40 keys by default and prints its true total AFTER the rows. It fails in ONE DIRECTION ONLY -- it can only hide keys, so it produces FALSE ABSENCES, which is the exact direction every SC-*-4 location row and DTX-AC4's residue are built on. It nearly put a false absence into this manifest: s3://opal-estate-report/kuzu_nessie_db (51MB, the store D11 exists to find) sat past the 40-row cut and I had drafted the sentence calling it absent. Corrected by head-object.

OBSERVATION (routed 72990, reproduced independently by 2.0.0_SA_COO~X and 0.7.0_AE_CloudOps~X, corrected COO~X's 'transient' diagnosis in 73003): passing a CONTENT PATTERN and --name to comp-find in the same call scans ZERO files and reports 0 hits over 0 scanned. Four arms at this seat, ARM 3 (immediate re-run) proved it DETERMINISTIC not transient; ARM 4 positive control showed a pattern with 65 known hits collapsing to zero. Later narrowed by 0.8.0_AE_CloudComp~Y: --files alongside --name is fine, confirmed independently at this seat (28,797 scanned).

SELF-REPORTED CONTROL FAILURE (routed 73076): before head-object corrected me I held a positive control that fired GREEN -- I grepped the same 40 truncated rows for 'estate-report', got 38 of 40, and read it as proof the sweep was sound. It proved my GREP worked and said nothing about whether the LISTING was complete: a control on the FILTER while the defect was in the POPULATION. Worse than no control, because it looks like rigour and stops the asking.

SELF-CAUGHT, PRE-SHIP: two vintage-measurement errors. (a) 'sort | tail -1' on Iceberg metadata filenames is LEXICOGRAPHIC, not chronological -- it reported graph_nodes at 2026-06-12 against a true 2026-08-26. (b) aws --query 'sort_by(Contents,&LastModified)[-1]' applies PER PAGE on a paginated list-*, so the 131,975-object graph_nodes metadata prefix returned ~130 values instead of one. Both are in CLAUDE.md's instrument-trap catalogue; both were caught before they reached a row; the remedy taken was to materialise the set and compute the max client-side.

SELF-CAUGHT, PRE-SHIP: the first hand-authored cut of this manifest declared stores_enumerated 39 against a population of 35 rows -- a typed denominator that did not match its own population, in a deliverable whose whole subject is printed denominators.
